subject: [PATCH nfs-utils 2/4] exports: Add riomode= and wiomode= export options

2026-10-27.patch_summary: This patch adds support for riomode= and wiomode= export options to the NFS exports system. These options allow users to specify how I/O operations are handled by the kernel, and can be used to improve performance or reduce latency. The patch also includes changes to handle kernels that do not support these options, and updates various files to reflect the new functionality. Specifically, it adds a function to check if the running kernel supports riomode/wiomode, and modifies the mountd daemon to drop these options on unsupported kernels instead of leaving the export unmountable.
